description: This file defines a wizard interface for setting default journals in a point of sale module, including functions for retrieving and updating journal configurations.

classes.name: wizard_default_journal
classes.description: A wizard interface class for managing default journal settings in POS configuration.

methods.name: _set_default_journal
methods.description: Sets default journal configurations based on user input, updating or creating journal records accordingly.

methods.name: _get_defaults
methods.description: Retrieves current default journal settings to populate the wizard form.
